Execute iLINCS API request with error handling

Source: R/getSignature.R
dot-executeSignatureRequest.Rd

This internal function safely executes an httr2 request and captures errors instead of raising them, allowing downstream functions to handle them appropriately.

Usage

.executeSignatureRequest(request, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

request

An httr2_request object to be executed.

verbose

Logical indicating whether to display request details. Default is FALSE.

Value

An httr2_response object, including error responses that would normally cause httr2 to raise an error.

Details

This function configures the request to not raise errors automatically on HTTP error status codes (4xx, 5xx) by using httr2::req_error(). Instead, error responses are returned as response objects that can be processed by .processSignatureResponse() to generate appropriate error messages with context.

The function handles:

  • Network connection errors

  • HTTP error status codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 500, etc.)

  • Timeout errors

  • Other httr2 request failures
